chapters: Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chɨkka jix tɨ'ɨ no'ch maa'n bhaan gu Kananeos.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' gu Judaa jix tɨ'ɨ; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhagia' gu oidha' gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Judaa gu Simeoon xibhɨk; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Kananeo tu' gio tu jiim bɨndak; mi' dhɨr gu Simeoon ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh gu Kananeo gu Pereseo; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Besek mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Adoni-besek gu Besek gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' tu' gu Kananeo gu Pereseo.
Gu' gu' gu Adoni-besek gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhiadat jix duñia' gu noobh tɨɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Adoni-besek; gio ba' gu Setenta gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh tɨɨt jix duñia' iigɨsda' bɨtaa'n gu vaak na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu Jerusalem pai' jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jix dhaav na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Kananeo jix daa gɨ' kavɨk saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Judaa bhaan gu Kananeo jix daa gu ebroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k gu Kîriat-arba; gio ba' tu' gu Sesai gu Aiman gu Talmai.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñka' gu Debir va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kîriat-seper.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaleb; na gu ñi'ook gu Kîriat-seper gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Axa mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk jix ali' gu Kaleb; gio ba' jix maa gu Axa mar u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat yooxi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Kaleb jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na jix maa gu oidha' gio suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu Kaleb jix maa suudai' buusñi jiix suudai' buusñi.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kineo jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Judaa oidha' jix gaki gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Arad; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix daa bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Judaa xibhɨk gu Simeoon tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kananeo jix daa gu Sepat; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham gu orma.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Judaa gu Gasa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Askaloon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ekroon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' kavɨk; gu' cham oi'ñka' ko'kmarak.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ebroon gu Kaleb na ja'p gu Moisees ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu ma'nkam gu Anak.
Gu' gu' gu Jebuseo jix daa gu Jerusalem cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jebuseo jix daa bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gio gu vaak gu Josee jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Josee jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-el kiicham va'k gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ busaak kiicham gui'p; gio ba' jano' ba'k kiicham chulhiiñchuda' bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k kiicham tu' gu kuchii; gu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu jum duu gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu eteos kiicham jup tɨɨt gu tasi'; gio ba' dhi' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Tampoko gu Manasees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-sean tu' taañpu' tu' gu Taanak taañpu' tu' gu Dor taañpu' tu' gu Ibleam taañpu' tu' oi'ñka' gu Megiddo taañpu'; gu' gu Kananeo jix daa dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ tu' na jix kavɨk gu Kananeo bopxi'ñ gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim gu Kananeo jix daa gu Geser; gio ba' va'k jix daa gu Kananeo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sabuloon oi'ñka' gu Kîtron oi'ñka' gu Naalol; gu' gu Kananeo jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aser oi'ñka' gu Akô oi'ñka' gu Sidoon gu Alab gu Aksib gu elba gu Apek gu Reod.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aser tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos oi'ñka' gu oidha'; na gu' cham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Neptalii oi'ñka' gu Bet-semes oi'ñka' gu Bet-anat gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos oi'ñka' gu oidha'; gu' jix bɨɨx duu bopxi'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Bet-semes gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Bet-anat.
Jano' ba' gu Amorreos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk; na cham jix dhaav vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amorreo jix daa gu kavɨk gu eres gu Ajaloon gu Saalbiin; gu' na ja'p gu novɨ gu vaak gu Josee jix bhɨɨ tu' na jix kavɨk jix duu bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo ka't dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akrabim dɨr gu jodai jiix.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ gu Gilgal gu Bokîm; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook tattat; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham mɨɨjidha' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia'; gu' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gio tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Bokîm; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Josuee ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu maa'nkar na ba' bia'ka'.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Josuee bɨx gu ñi'ook daraa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu Josuee buupui bɨx buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chamaam mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Gaas.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tattat; gio ba' jix búup mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baales.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat ka't jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam mi'p xikoolh o'lhia; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia gu Baal gu Astarot.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel do'ñcho gu noobh obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' jix buus gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan na ba' cham bhai' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam jootom gu bhóogɨt tattat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham jix duu.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jir bɨx bhai' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook kuiñcha tu jiim.
Gu' gu' vaak jodai jir bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu juan tu' vupui bhaan; gio ba' cham tu' buimɨi tu' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' daak gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel; na gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan tattat cham dhu'npi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vupui bhaan matgɨm chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu Josuee na pai' dhuuk jix koi.
Na ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Israeel tu' nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios jiim gu ñi'ook na ja'p tattat gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp cham tu' do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' dhi' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Israeel bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam cham bɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kanaan.
Na ba' na ba' gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham jum duu va'k cham.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam chiñia' gu Pilisteos bɨx gu Kananeos gu Sidonios gu ebeos oi'ñka' gu kavɨk gu Liibano; gio ba' dɨr gu kavɨk gu Baal-ermoon bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu amat.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel na ba' maachim tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tattat gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oi'ñka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos gu eteos gu Amorreos gu Pereseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ jix maa ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baales duiñxim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel gu noobh gu Kusan-risataim gu gɨ'kora' gu Mesopotamia; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Kusan-risataim.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam boosolh gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr maachim gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk jix ali' gu Kaleb.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Israeel jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Kusan-risataim gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gu novɨ bhaan gu Kusan-risataim.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix koi gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel duñia' cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab bhaan gu Israeel na gu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ baidhak gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Amalek ka't tu' naaka'n gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ kiicham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moabitas mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam boosolh gu Aod gu mar gu Gera gu Benjamita ga'ra' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mɨjɨ bɨɨx gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab.
Jano' ba' gu Aod ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook mu'muk novɨ maa'nkar jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨtaa'n jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba' ka't gu Egloon gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr duiñxim gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook no'ñ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' moor bɨɨx bɨx vupui bhaan mi'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aod ka't daakat; gio ba' gu Aod jix aa'; mi' dhɨr no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu'; jano' ba' jix búup.
Gu' gu' gu Aod gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ o'nsop jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook vook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbiapui gio bhaan jajar cham jix buusñi vook; gio ba' jix buus.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu Aod naadat gu ñi'ook bhaan kiki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs tu duukam ñɨi'ñ kiki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' dhaibu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm cham kiki'ñgob jix bhɨɨ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu oidha' jix koi.
Gu' gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aod gu ñi'ook bhɨi duiñxim gu Seirat.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't kia'mi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaav bɨɨx gu kavɨk vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' obhɨɨ'ñ gu Moabitas gu noobh; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu Moab cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moabitas na ja'p mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bɨx jix kavɨk bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Israeel; gio ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Samgar gu mar gu Anat naaka'n gu chichio'ñ gu Pilisteos bɨɨx gu vaakax; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Aod.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan jix gɨ'kora' gu Asor; gio ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siisara jix daa gu aroset gu Gentes.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu u'vɨ gu Deebora gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu u'vɨ gu Lapidot.
Jano' ba' gu Deebora jix daa bɨtaa'n gu novɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Rama gu Bet-el gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' bhañ tɨɨt gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam gu Kedes gu Neptalii; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui gu ja'tkam gu kavɨk gu Tabor jix bhɨɨ bɨndak mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu gu Kisoon gu Siisara ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jabiin bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham kapbhai' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Barak jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu jiim; gu' tu' cham tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu jiim bɨndak; gu' cham ka't nɨidhat gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu novɨ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Siisara; gio ba' kɨkbo gu Deebora ka't bɨɨx gu Barak gu Kedes.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Barak gu Sabuloon gu Neptalii gu Kedes jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Deebora jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu eber gu Kineo gu ma'nkam gu obab jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kineos gu ñi'ook vaak zel bɨɨx ka'm gu Saananim ju'ñdharan gu Kedes.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siisara na ja'p gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam ka't jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu Tabor.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Siisara bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't dɨr gu aroset gu Gentes bɨɨx ka'm jix duu gu Kisoon.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Deebora gu Barak; gio ba' bamii'; na gu' dhi' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu Siisara gu noobh; jano' ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu' gu Barak jix dhaav gu kavɨk gu Tabor mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siisara bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu kuchii vupui bhaan gu Barak; gio ba' gu Siisara jix dhaav tɨɨt.
Gu' gu' gu Barak chɨ'ɨɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu aroset gu Gentes bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siisara gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm cham gu ñi'ook tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Siisara gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt vaak zel gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber gu Kineo; na gu' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Asor gu vaak gu eber gu Kineo.
Ba' jix aa' gamai' gu Jael gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siisara; gio ba' gu Jawatan tu' cham choo'n; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va vaak zel jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i gu suudai' no'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix kupi'ook bii'm jix maa i'i gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' ki'ñgob vaak zel tu' jix bhai'x daraibu' tu' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch oi'ñdha' tu' tu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber jix bhɨɨ dhi' vaak zel jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ suudai' u'va dhi' gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Barak gu Siisara gu Jael jix buus tu jiim; gio ba' jix ai tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui pai' ka't gu Siisara jix koi bɨɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jiiñ gu Deebora bɨɨx gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam bham.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel na gu' gu ja'tkam tu' aagak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seir gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tu' yooxi' gu Edom gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr tɨbaa'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Sinaii vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Samgar gu mar gu Anat gu tanoolh gu Jael gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' taañpu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu Deebora gu naan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xixiibkam gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't kiki'ñgob; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook u'u kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ oo'm jix bhai'x gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu Israeel bɨɨx jix bhai' aagak tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chooto ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨroon u'u gat gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai' gu Israeel; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu Despierta gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Deebora; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bamii' gu Barak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Abinoam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu bhaan jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim jix buus tatk bhaan gu Amalek bhaan tu' gu Benjamiin bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Makîr jix dhaav chiñia' gu Sabuloon gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gio gu Issakâr jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu Deebora; gio ba' na ja'p gu Issakâr gio gu Barak jix dhaas tɨɨt gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rubeen ka't gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu Rubeen jix bɨɨx duu gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Dan gu ñi'ook juruuñ ju'ñdharan gu Mantuubose gu Aser gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Sabuloon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' koi'm gu Neptalii yooxi'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan gu Taanak ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Megiddo gu' cham bhɨɨk jix duñia' tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu si'avag dɨr bhaan gu Siisara.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhi'ñbak gu Kisoon jix bhai'x bhi'ñbak gu Kisoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' kavaayo jix kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Meros nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na gu' cham tɨɨtɨs gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber gu Kineo; gio ba' bhaan gu u'vɨ ka't vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' jix maa bii'm; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kɨɨ'n; gio ba' gu Siisara naaka'n mo'o gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt jix duñia'; na pai' jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu naan gu Siisara gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jiiñak tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham jupaabkamu'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gaagam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gook; gio ba' jix uam na ba' gu Siisara jix uam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix uam na ba' baakux jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu' ka't na ja'p gu tas na pai' dhuuk gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix utu'ñ oo'm.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh gu Madiaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu Madiaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel kuiñcha gu Madianitas jix duu gu kakkavɨk gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na ja'p gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Madianitas gu Amalekitas; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa; gio ba' cham jugi gu Israeel tu' kakneer tu' gu vaakax tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajidha' bɨɨx vaak zel jix gɨ' na ja'p gu ñi'ook cham ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' tu' jix ai; gio ba' aajidha' gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Madianitas; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel a'lhiok duuñ gu Jawatan Dios kuiñcha gu Madianitas.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ bɨx vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Yo jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Amorreos gu oidha'; gu' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix daa bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Opra ka't gu Joas gu Abieserita; gio ba' gu mar gu Gedeoon ka't tu jiim tiriik gu Jawatan na ba' jix duñia' gu Madianitas.

Jano' ba' gu Gedeoon jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch gu ñi'ook tu' daam bɨx dhi' duukat bɨx kɨɨ'p taata'n tattat jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr cham jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Madianitas.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx dhi' gu kavɨk u'ua'tɨda' gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Madianitas; mi' dhɨr cham tu' jootsa' tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Miren ja'tkam vaak gampai' gu Manasees tu' jix ali' gu vaak gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Madianitas na ja'p gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Yo tu' soi'ñ tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Yo bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gedeoon chiiw gu takarui' cham jabka' gu Epa; gio ba' jix dhaas gu chuukug bɨtaa'n mii' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tai jodai kavɨk gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka'; mi' dhɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Gedeoon ka't nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios buupui nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n cham koi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Gedeoon jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu Jeobaa-salom; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Opra gu Abieseritas.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Gedeoon jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ tu duukam tu' jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu ñi'ook duñia' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu taat gu chichio'ñ kiicham jix duu gu tukaa'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu xibh na pai' dhuuk kiicham jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal ka't gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan ka't maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan mii' dhɨr gook gu jodai' na jix uam maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Joas tu' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ kiicham gui'p gu Joas.
Na gu' jix buusñi mai' gu mar na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' tu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal tu' gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan ka't.

Jano' ba' gu Joas jix aa' bɨx mi'p ju'ñdharan; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baal dodhia' gu Kualkuiera gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu xibh; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jup tɨɨt gu Gedeoon gu Jerobaal; na gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baal bhaan jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Madianitas gu Amalekitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jum daa'ñ bhɨi yooxi' gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Manasees gio jum daa'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' bhañ gu Aser gu Sabuloon gu Neptalii moor jix ai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gedeoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ na ja'p tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't; gio ba' tu' jix gaki bɨx gu oidha' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu novɨ na ja'p tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu vupui jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bham; na gu ñi'ook dɨr gu kavɨk gu Galaad; mi' dhɨr suulh gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu'; jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' bɨndak; gu' no'x tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' dhi' cham bɨndak jix duñia' cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Gedeoon; mi' dhɨr no'x gu suudai' bɨɨx nɨɨn na ja'p gu ñi'ook gagai' dɨlhkob; jano' ba' no'x bhaan kɨkbok na ba' i'i.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu novɨ gu chin vaik gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan kɨkbok na ba' i'i gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon; gio ba' bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' dodhia' kapbhai' gu Madianitas gu noobh; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ja'tkam gu noobh bhañ bɨx gu Israelitas maa'n vaak zel mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' ga'ra' yooxi' gu Madiaan gu ñi'ook.
