Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n jix dhaav tu' bɨɨx gu Para jix duñia' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' gu noobh jix duñia' yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav bɨɨx gu Para jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ka't yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu Madiaan gu Amalek bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix ai jix duñia' na ja'p oo' gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gedeoon gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook duiñchu' bham; gio ba' gu Miren tu'; na gu takarui' kai' vaas bɨɨx ka'm yooxi' gu Madiaan vaak zel jix duñia' bhaan jiix vaak zel.

Ba' jix aa' duiñchu'; gio ba' dhi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu Gedeoon gu mar gu Joas gu chio'ñ gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu Madianitas bɨɨx bɨx yooxi'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Gedeoon jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' yooxi' gu Israeel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix búup gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' yooxi' gu Madiaan gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu chichio'ñ vaik jix maa maa'n gu noobh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ja'p tu' jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam yooxi' na ja'p tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx no'm; gio ba' kuichdha' jano' ba' xikoolh bɨx yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gedeoon gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ baidhak gɨ'kora' ja'tkam yooxi' ba'k jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu noobh gu ñi'ook a'aa' bɨɨx jix maa; gio ba' gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook yooxi'; gio ba' bɨx yooxi' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam jiboi'ññor.

Gu' gu' vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu kuchii maa'n bhaan duiñchu' bɨx yooxi'; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-sitta bhaan gu Kerera bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Abel-meola gu Tabbat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu Neptalii gu Aser bɨx gu Manasees bhiadat gu Madianitas.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bhañ bɨx gu kavɨk gu Epraim bham; gio ba' gu Madianitas gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-bara gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Aañ bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Bet-bara gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gook chiñia' gu Madianitas gu Oreb gu Seeb; gio ba' mu'aa gu Oreb jodai kavɨk gu Oreb gu Seeb mu'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seeb; mi' dhɨr bhiadat gu Madianitas aichdhak ɨɨbhidham gu Oreb gu Seeb gu Gedeoon baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim gui'p; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Madiaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu Epraim tutkɨ gu Abieser.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu Oreb gu Seeb chiñia' gu Madiaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' duñia' na ja'p jano' ba' bhaan tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Gedeoon gu Jordaan na ba' gu ñi'ook vaik gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baidhak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sukkot; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam dhɨt gu chin gu takarui'; na gu' tu' gu Seba gu Salmunna gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sukkot tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna gu novɨ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch gu takarui' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gedeoon; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug bɨɨx jo'ii' oidha' jix gaki.
Ba' jix aa' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Penuel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Penuel tu ñi'ook na ja'p a'ga gu Sukkot.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Penuel bham; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' bhi'ñbak.

Jano' ba' gu Seba gu Salmunna mi'p gu Karkor bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bɨx jix duñia' bɨx yooxi'; gio ba' koko'kam jix duñia' chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii.
Na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Gedeoon bhaan oi'ñka' vaak zel baasɨ'n gu ux na tu ibai' gu Noba gu Jogbea naaka'n yooxi' na gu' ka't ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba gu Salmunna chɨ'ɨɨk; gio ba' gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan gu Seba gu Salmunna bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu Gedeoon gu mar gu Joas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k gu tas.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sukkot tu ñi'ook jix maa ua'nak gu ñi'ook gu Sukkot daraa kɨɨv gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' baakɨk gu Sukkot; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba gu Salmunna bhaan bham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna gu novɨ na ba' no'ch gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ daraa kiicham jo'ii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx gu Sukkot.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhi'ñbak gu Penuel mu'aa kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ ko'kmarak mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu Tabor tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu naan; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tu' cham kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeter maa'nkam mar; gio ba' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu' cham gu kuchii na gu' ga'ra' choo'n; na ka't gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' bamii' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' na ja'p gu chio'ñ jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu Gedeoon jix búup mu'aa gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jix ai jix duñia' baakux.
Jano' ba' gu Israelitas gui'p gu Gedeoon; gio ba' tu' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan tu' gu mar gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Madiaan.
Gu' gu' gu Gedeoon jix aa'; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar aapi'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gedeoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n jix maa; na gu' jix uam jodai jix duñia' gu Ismaelitas; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' maa'n.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix bhai'x jix uam jodai; gio ba' cham jajannulhi'ñ ñakaabma' gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan cham jix ai baakux.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Gedeoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nukadham kiicham gu Opra; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel bhaan mii' dhɨr pai'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Gedeoon gu vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu Madiaan vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup mo'o; gio ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' oo'm gu tanoolh gu Gedeoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jerobaal gu mar gu Joas ka't jix daa gu vaak.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu Gedeoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam moor na gu' jix duñia' mumua'da' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ka't gu Sikêm gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Gedeoon gu mar gu Joas jix bhai' gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' tukga'n gu taat gu Joas gu Opra gu Abieseritas.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix koi gu Gedeoon gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baales jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios gu Baal-berit.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu vaak gu Jerobaal gu Gedeoon jurtu'nka' bɨx xoi'kam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Pueese gu Abimelek gu mar gu Jerobaal gu Sikêm gu ja'tkam gu naan bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu taat gu naan bham.

Jano' ba' tu' soi'ñ tu ñi'ook maatɨt bɨx gu Sikêm; gio ba' gu ñi'ook namki' gu ñi'ook tutkɨ jix gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Akordaos tu' jix duñia' o'o gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu naan maatɨt bɨx gu Sikêm bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu Abimelek na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal-berit bɨɨx gu Abimelek gu chichio'ñ jix bhai'x bhiadat.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu vaak gu taat gu Opra mu'aa gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bhaan gu jodai; gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jotam jix ali' gu mar gu Jerobaal.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Sikêm bɨɨx bɨx gu vaak gu Millo jix bɨɨx duu gu Abimelek gu gɨ'kora' mia'n ka't gu Sikêm.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu Jotam ka't jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Gerisim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Sikêm; na gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gui'p; gio ba' gu Reina bhaan no'ch.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; gio ba' no'ñ bɨɨx kuiñcha gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ nɨidhat tu' jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu u'u iigɨx; gio ba' jiim tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix aa' iigɨx; gio ba' no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' gu i'bhɨ tu' jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; gio ba' no'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ tu' jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p jano' ba' bɨx gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jiim tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa' gu u'u; gio ba' tu' tu'r gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n ɨkgiga'n; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu tai gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Abimelek tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam bɨɨx gu Jerobaal bɨɨx gu vaak tu' jix duñia' jurtu'nka' tu duukam gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Madiaan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak gu taat gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ bhaan gu jodai; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Sikêm gu Abimelek gu mar gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na gu' xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jerobaal bɨɨx gu vaak gu Abimelek gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abimelek jix duñia' gu Sikêm gu vaak gu Millo; gio ba' gu tai gu Sikêm gu vaak gu Millo jix duñia' gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jotam ka't gu Beer juruuñ kuiñcha gu Abimelek xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel vaik.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abimelek gu chichio'ñ gu Sikêm; na gu Sikêm jix búup bhaan gu Abimelek.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bhaan gu Abimelek xibhɨk mu'aa bhaan gu chichio'ñ gu Sikêm gu noobh na ba' kooda' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Sikêm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Sikêm; gio ba' gu Sikêm jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gamai' yooxi' gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu; gio ba' baakɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios koi'mɨk i'i gu Abimelek.

Ba' jix aa' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed; gio ba' chɨkka gu Abimelek gu ñi'ook gu Sikêm na ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu mar gu Jerobaal cham gu Sebul gu Serbid gu chio'ñ gu emor gu taat gu Sikêm; gu' gu ñi'ook dua'ñ tu juan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa dhi' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ tu' gu Abimelek; gio ba' chɨtda gu Abimelek; mi' dhɨr jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu Sebul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham tɨiñ gu ñi'ook gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed daak.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abimelek bham; gio ba' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tɨbiap gu Sikêm jix duñia' mia'n kiicham bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bamii' jano' gu tukaa' tu' gu ja'tkam bɨndak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh jix buus gu tas tu' kiicham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx bhaan tu' jix duu bɨɨx bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu tukaa' gu Abimelek bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Sikêm bɨɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed jix buus jix dhaas ba'k ki'ñgob kiicham; gio ba' gu Abimelek bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Gaal gu ja'tkam gu Sebul; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Sebul jix aa'; jano' ba' ɨkgiga'n gu kakkavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Gaal gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiokda'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jupaabkamu'n gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam gu Meonenim.
Jano' ba' gu Sebul jix aa'; gio ba' duukat jano' mii' dhɨr ñiokda' bham; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu Abimelek na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Sal jano' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal jix buus vupui bhaan gu Sikêm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Abimelek.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abimelek vupui bhaan; gio ba' ia'rɨ mui'x bɨɨx ka'm ba'k ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu Abimelek gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aruma; gio ba' gu Sebul mai' gu Gaal gu ja'tkam na ba' cham gu Sikêm.
Jano' ba' ka't buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu ja'tkam jix buus yooxi'; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik jix dhaas yooxi'; gio ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam busaak kiicham; mi' dhɨr jix búup bhaan tu' naaka'n.
Na gu' gu Abimelek gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ba'k ki'ñgob kiicham; gio ba' gook bɨx mi'p yooxi'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abimelek kiicham bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ mu'aa gu ja'tkam ka't kiicham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bɨx mi'p bhi'ñbak gu Sikêm baap gu kavɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Berit.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Abimelek na ja'p bɨx bhi'ñbak gu Sikêm mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abimelek gu kavɨk gu Salmoon bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abimelek gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u bhaan gu ñi'ook bham gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr tu' na ja'p tu'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gio maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhiadat gu Abimelek jix dhaas ju'ñdharan gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu tai bɨɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' bɨx bhi'ñbak gu Sikêm jix koko' na ja'p jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek ka't gu Tebes; gio ba' jix dhaas jix duñia' gu Tebes jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham ka't bhi'ñbak jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ bɨx gu Jawatan kiicham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan kiki'ñgob jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhai'x bhi'ñbak.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Abimelek bhi'ñbak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob bhi'ñbak na ba' gu tai.
Gu' gu' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan mo'o gu Abimelek jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham tu'; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ mu'aa; jano' ba' kutun kavɨk gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix koi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Israelitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi gu Abimelek jix bɨɨx duu maa'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Abimelek cham bhai' bhaan gu taat mu'aa gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx cham bhai' gu chichio'ñ gu Sikêm gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ɨɨbhidham; gio ba' mu'ai gu Jotam gu mar gu Jerobaal suudai' u'va bhaan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek jix búup na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu Tola gu mar gu Puua gu mar gu Dodo gu chio'ñ gu Issakâr jix daa gu Samir gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi ka't jix duñia' gu Samir.
Jano' ba' bhaan jix búup gu Jair gu Galaadita gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu Jair bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Jair ka't jix duñia' gu Kamoon.

Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu Baales gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Siria gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidoon gu Jawatan Dios gu Moab gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Amorreo gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Judaa bhaan gu Benjamiin gu vaak gu Epraim; gio ba' ka't gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ bhaan tu'; na gu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Baales.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu Amorreos gu Ammonitas gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Sidoon gu Amalek gu Maoon jiiñkɨk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duuñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' namkidhat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu vupui tu' bɨɨx no'ch na ja'p xoi'kam tu'; jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't kuiñcha tu jiim gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon yooxi' gu Galaad; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel yooxi' gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ja'tkam gu Galaad gui'p maa'n; gio ba' chɨkka ka't kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ka't mo'o bhaan bɨx gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu Jeptee gu Galaadita gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu mar ganai' ka't gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Galaad gio ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam; na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu mai' gu Jeptee tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu taat na gu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeptee kuiñcha gu ja'tkam jix daa gu oidha' gu Tob; gio ba' jum daa'ñ bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ jix bhai'x bɨɨx jix buus.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix duu bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ko'kmarak bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel daraa gu Galaad jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeptee gu oidha' gu Tob.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka' chulhiiñdha' na ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee jix aa' daraa gu Galaad; na pai' dhuuk cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu taat gu ñi'ook jano' tu' na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' daraa gu Galaad tu ñi'ook gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kuiñcha jano' tu' na ba' bɨɨx no'ch bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon mo'o bɨx gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeptee jano' ba' daraa gu Galaad; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' vupui bhaan tu' jix duñia' tu' mo'o.
Jano' ba' daraa gu Galaad tu ñi'ook gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tu' cham na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jeptee suudai' u'va bɨɨx daraa gu Galaad gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jeptee tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jeptee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap tu' na ba' bhaan bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeptee; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok gu Jordaan; na ba' jano' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨip gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas.
Na ba' na ba' a'ga; gio ba' gu Jeptee tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel cham jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' gu Moab tu' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Gu' gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Israeel gu Ejipto jix jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo gu Kades.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Israeel bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom bham; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom cham; jano' ba' bhañ gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Kades.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jiimchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Edom pai' gu Moab bai'ñpu' gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' pai' gu Moab yooxi' dhi' baasɨ'n gu Arnoon cham baap gu ñi'ook gu Moab; na gu' gu Arnoon gu ñi'ook gu Moab.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm pai'.
Gu' gu' gu Seoon cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel na ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k gu Seoon bɨx gu ja'tkam jix dhaas yooxi' gu Jaas bhaan gu Israeel.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel do'ñcho gu Seoon bɨx gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Israeel bɨx gu oidha' gu Amorreo jix daa mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok dɨr oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan.
Na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amorreos vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Kêmos gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim oi'ñdha' cham bia'ka' tu' bia'ka' no'ch bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jano' gu ñi'ook tutkɨ gu Balak gu mar gu Sepor gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix duñia' bhaan gu Israeel bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel tu' dhi' jix daa gu ñi'ook vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu esboon taañpu' gu Aroer taañpu' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Arnoon gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Na ba' tu' cham tu' uañi'ñ bhaan tu' gu' tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jir bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeptee bhañ.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Galaad gu Manasees; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Mispa gu Galaad; jano' ba' gu Mispa gu Galaad gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jeptee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu' kɨɨsa' gu Ammonitas gu noobh.
Na pai' dhuuk no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob gu vaak na pai' dhuuk gu Ammonitas bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jeptee gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu Aroer bɨɨx ka'm gu Minnit gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu Ammonitas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeptee gu Mispa gu vaak mar u'vɨ jix buus bɨɨx ka't; gio ba' cham ga'ra' mai' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ tu'r jix duñia' tu'; na gu' tu' jix kupi'ook gu chin gu Jawatan Dios cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix kupi'ook gu chin gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui tu' na ja'p jix buus gu chin gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga gu taat; gio ba' dhi'; mi' dhɨr gook masaa'n gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook masaa'n; jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook masaa'n gu taat tu' jurtu'nka' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel oi'ñga' jix duñia' gu Israeel mar u'vɨ gu Jeptee gu Galaadita maakobh gu tanoolh oi'ñga'.

Jano' ba' gu Juntaandose gu chio'ñ gu Epraim gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham mɨmɨim na ba' bɨndak gu Nosotros gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tai gu vaak bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu noobh.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeptee bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Galaad bhaan gu Epraim; na gu' gu Galaad gu Epraim na gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Epraim gu Galaaditas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Epraim gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' gu Galaaditas gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan gu Epraim; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu Epraim ka't jix duñia' chɨtda gu Galaad tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Eprateo tu' tu ñi'ook cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' jano' tu' gu Sibolet; mi' dhɨr chɨtda gu Sibolet; na gu' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr; gio ba' jano' ba' gu novɨ ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr jix koko' jano' ba' gu Epraim oo'm gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix koi gu Jeptee gu Galaadita ka't jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Ibsan gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' jix bhɨɨ mai' gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Ibsan ka't jix duñia' gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Eloon gu Sabulonita gu ñi'ook gu Israeel mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Eloon gu Sabulonita ka't jix duñia' gu Ajaloon gu oidha' gu Sabuloon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Abdoon gu mar gu illel gu Piratonita.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' oo'm gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Abdoon gu mar gu illel gu Piratonita ka't jix duñia' gu Piratoon gu oidha' gu Epraim gu kavɨk gu Amalek.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Pilisteos oo'm.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Sora bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Manoa; gio ba' gu u'vɨ ka't gu ñi'ook cham pai' dhuuk ka't.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu u'vɨ jix ñi'ñ nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook cham; gu' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' jugi gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; na gu' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan mo'o na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios dɨr vook kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va tu' gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook duukat tu' chɨkka ka't tu' jix aa' gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu mar; na ba' jano' cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' jugi gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr vook ka't gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Manoa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan tu' soi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jano' jix ai no'ch bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' maaxilhia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Manoa; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu u'vɨ kua' yooxi'; gu' gu chio'ñ gu Manoa cham ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ dai'bus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va tu' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Manoa chɨ'ɨɨk gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Manoa; gio ba' gu u'vɨ nukadham bɨx tu'x tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa suudai' u'va; gio ba' cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' cham jugi gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr tu' nukadham bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' chiiw vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Manoa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jugi gu takarui'; gu' tu' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham bhai'x gu Manoa jum duu nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu Manoa jix bhɨɨ chiiw gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan jodai kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' nobii'ñ jix duu ñiata gu Manoa gu u'vɨ.

Na gu' na gu' ka't na ja'p mɨmɨim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu tɨkɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ mɨmɨim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ñiata gu Manoa gu u'vɨ gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Manoa tu' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Manoa ka't nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Manoa gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu ñi'ook koi na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buupui.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kooda' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ gu noobh maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' tu'x tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Samsoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu Dan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sora gu Estaol.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Samsoon gu Timna jix ñi' gu Timna gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan bham; gio ba' tu' buupui gu Timna gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' gu taat gu naan gui'p; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ja'tkam tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu Samsoon jix aa' gu taat; na gu' gu u'vɨ na gu' gu vupui.
Gu' gu' gu taat gu naan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bua' bhaan gu Pilisteos; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Samsoon jix dhaav bɨɨx gu taat bɨɨx gu naan gu Timna; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va gu Timna maavɨt bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na ja'p chiiw cham mambhɨɨx cham tu' gu novɨ; gio ba' cham jix maa gu taat tu' gu naan ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu u'vɨ ka't jix duñia' gu Samsoon.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr dhɨt gu tanoolh na ba' jix bhɨɨ jix ai'chdhix na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug jix koi maavɨt gu chuukug maavɨt ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh ka't gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu taat gu naan jix maa gio; gu' cham jix ñi'ñ ka't jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug maavɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu suudai' u'va gu taat gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu tas bhaan biipibop.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus jugi jix kavɨk jix buus; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gui'p gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham tu' gu vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr tɨɨgim na ba' bia'ka'.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' gu taat tu' gu naan jix duñia'; gio ba' dua'ñ gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kɨɨv gu tanoolh chooto'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook na gu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh va'k gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk maavɨt.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix dhaav gu Askaloon tu' naaka'n gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' dhaagɨk jix maa jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' ka't gu vaak gu taat; jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon ka't duiñchu' bɨɨx va'k.

Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook oraa' tiriik gu Samsoon jix duñia' gu u'vɨ bɨɨx chiiw bham; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gu' gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baakɨi.
Ba' jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñchu'; gu' gu ja'tkam jix ali' cham pai'.
Jano' ba' gu Samsoon jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos tu' cham bhai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Samsoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik dhaagɨk jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'iim gu Pilisteos oidha' u'va.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu Pilisteos; gio ba' chɨkka jix duu dhi' ka't tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Samsoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Timnateo na gu' gu u'vɨ jix maa duiñchu'; jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu tai gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samsoon; gio ba' dua'ñ gu ñi'ook gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' jix dhaav jumpa'n gu jodai' na jix uam gu Etam.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas yooxi' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lei.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan no'ch tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Samsoon jix duñia' na ba' duñia' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa jumpa'n gu jodai' na jix uam gu Etam gui'p gu Samsoon; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat tu' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap na ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu Samsoon jix aa'; jano' ba' cham kooda'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kapbhai' gu noobh; gu' cham tu' kooda'; jano' ba' bɨɨx gook jix vɨɨk tu' jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Lei gu Pilisteos moor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan mi'p na ja'p bɨɨx gu tai gu ñi'ook ia'rɨ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ tu' naaka'n bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samsoon; gio ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gɨ' kavɨk gook gɨ' kavɨk; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' a'gidhimɨk ñiokda' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Ramat-lei.
Ba' jix aa' ua'tulhdhidha' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix maa dhi' tulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu duukam; mi' dhɨr koi tu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't moor gu suudai' jix i'i gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; na ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu En-akkore gu Lei bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Samsoon gu Gasa jix ñi' gu u'vɨ ganai' chɨbiapui.

Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Gasa; gio ba' gu Samsoon tɨbiap jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ki'ñgob kiicham; jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' bham; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tasi' gu xibh; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' kooda'.

Gu' gu' gu Samsoon jix koox bɨɨx ka'm ɨraab gu tukaa'; gio ba' ɨraab gu tukaa' jix búup dhaagɨk kiki'ñgob kiicham bɨɨx gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Sorek gu Dalila.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs chiñia' gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' gu Engaañale gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ba'; mi' dhɨr maa'n no'ch tu' maa'n jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dalila gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx kɨɨv cham jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p no'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos aichdhak kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' na ja'p dhi' na pai' dhuuk gu tai; jano' ba' cham gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dalila gu Samsoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jano' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix vɨɨk bɨɨx matgɨm ka't gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' na ja'p no'x gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dalila jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨɨk bɨɨx; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' mi'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gu' na ja'p.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dalila gu Samsoon; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu Deskuubreme jano' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' kɨɨv mo'o bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' gu' gu ñi'ook dhi' bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' vaik mui'kim cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ ka't koi'm.

Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk mo'o gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' jix duñia' gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios dɨr vook gu naan; jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu kavɨk jix bhaan tu' jix duñia' na ja'p bɨx gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Dalila ka't jix duñia' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bhañ tɨɨt chiñia' gu Pilisteos bham; na gu' gu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia' na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr chiñia' gu Pilisteos tɨɨtɨs jix duñia' gu novɨ tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan kɨkbok; gio ba' tɨɨgim gu chio'ñ kɨɨv mo'o kua'da' tu jiim gu kavɨk jix ai'chdhix.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix duñia' na ja'p; jano' ba' cham pu'ñir gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't.
Gu' gu' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu vupui bhɨɨk gu Gasa; gio ba' bɨɨx na ba' kuupa'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mo'o kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr ka't.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Dagoon gu Jawatan Dios na ba'; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Dios gu noobh gu Samsoon chulhiiñdha' bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Dios gu noobh chulhiiñdha' bhaamki'ñdha' gu oidha' ka't jix koi mui'x no'ch.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gui'p; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Samsoon na ba' vupui bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt gu Samsoon kuupa' jix duñia' vupui bhaan; jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' vaak zel bhaan jix duñia' gu vaak na ba' bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu vaak ka't jix bhuup gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ; gio ba' bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos mi'p; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ mi'p tɨɨgɨk gu Samsoon.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Samsoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' soi'ñ dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duñia' gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gook gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samsoon gook tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu vaak bɨɨx gu novɨ tu jiim bɨɨx o'nsop.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu vaak bhaan chiñia' bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mui'x vaak jodai ka't jix koi gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨk gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sora gu Estaol tukga'n gu taat gu Manoa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mikâs.

Ba' jix aa' gu naan; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai tu' jix bɨɨx duu tu' no'ñ dhi' tuumiñ; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu naan jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu naan jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai gu naan; gio ba' tu' dhi' tuumiñ gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ na ba' tu' gu mar na ba' na jax chu'm jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jano' tu'.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu naan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu naan jix toja jodai jix maa; gio ba' jix duu na jax chu'm jix duñia' tu jiim ka't jix duñia' gu vaak gu Mikâs.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' dhi' gu chio'ñ gu Mikâs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' maa'n jix duñia' na ja'p tutkɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-leem gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu Judaa ka't gu Lebita; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu chio'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Bet-leem gu Judaa na ba' tu' duaka' pai' bakia'; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu Epraim suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Mikâs na ba' duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikâs; gio ba' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebita jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Bet-leem gu Judaa duaka' pai' bakia'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Mikâs; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak ka' pai' gu taat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' mambhɨɨx jix toja jodai oidha' tas jajannulhi'ñ jugi; jano' ba' gu Lebita.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ñcho gu Lebita gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ga'ra' na ja'p maa'n gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebita mii' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't gu vaak gu Mikâs.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikâs; gio ba' jano' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Lebita gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; na gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na ba' pai' jix duñia' na gu' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan mɨjɨ bopxi'ñ jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu Sora gu Estaol na ba' xoi'kam gu oidha'; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu oidha'; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Mikâs gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p mi'p mia'n gu vaak gu Mikâs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Lebita; gio ba' jimɨɨk gui'p; mi' dhɨr chɨkka tu' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mikâs tu' jix duñia' na ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook xoi'kam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs gu Lais; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix daa ka't gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu Sidoon; mi' dhɨr cham ka't soo'mchulhdhak mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr dhi'; jano' ba' dhi' mi'p gu Sidonios cham ko'kmarak bɨɨx soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Sora gu Estaol gu ja'tkam gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; na gu' no'ch gu ñi'ook buupui gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu noobh; mi' dhɨr pai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch uañi'ñ ka't gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dan gu Sora gu Estaol gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Kîriat-jearim gu Judaa; gio ba' pai' mii' dhɨr pai' ka't tɨɨgim yooxi' gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Kîriat-jearim.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu kavɨk gu Epraim tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Mikâs.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Lais gui'p gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham na ja'p dhi' gu vaak cham tu'x jai'ch tu' na jax chu'm jix duñia' gu Mirad jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jimɨɨk tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebita gu vaak gu Mikâs tɨkka gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Dan mi'p gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ba'k ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' baap jix bhɨɨ na jax chu'm jix duñia' na jax chu'm ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ba'k ki'ñgob bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' baakɨk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu vaak gu Mikâs jix bhɨɨ na jax chu'm jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas gu novɨ bhaan gu chin bɨɨx no'ch na ba' chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tutkɨ tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu chio'ñ bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' dhaagɨk na jax chu'm suudai' u'va tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix dhaas a'aalh gu vaakax vupui bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Mikâs gu chichio'ñ oi'ñka' gu vaak mia'n gu vaak gu Mikâs jum daa'ñ bhiadat gu ma'nkam gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix maa jiiñak gu Dan suulhgia' suulh gu vupui gui'p gu Mikâs; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨma'n bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan gui'p; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiiñak bhaan no'ch cham ka't gio gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu bhóogɨt ñɨi'ñ gu Mikâs jix duñia' jix kavɨk gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Mikâs bɨɨma'n bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ga'ra' gu Lais gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kiicham bɨɨx gu tai.
Na gu' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' mi'p gu Sidoon cham ko'kmarak jugi bɨɨx soo'mchulhdhak; gio ba' kiicham ka't gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu Bet-reob; mi' dhɨr kiicham jix daa.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr kiicham gu Dan jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dan gu taat gu mar gu Israeel xoi'kam va'k tɨɨt kiicham gu Lais.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan jix búup na jax chu'm jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Gersoon gu mar gu Manasees gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bopxi'ñ gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix búup na jax chu'm gu Mikâs ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios juruuñ gu Silo.

Na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu Lebita gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Epraim ka't jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu Bet-leem gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' bhaan jum duu gu vaak gu taat gu Bet-leem gu Judaa juruuñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maakobh masaa'n.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ chɨ'ɨɨk na ba' ñiokda' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baidhak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' jimchu' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus jix bhai'x; gio ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu taat gu vaak vaik gu tanoolh jugi i'i.
Ba' jix aa' maakobh gu tanoolh na ja'p jix búup gu xibh jix búup gio gu Lebita na ba' jix duu gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu chin gu takarui' mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa gook tɨtda:―Aañ koi'mɨk i'i; gio ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa' gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ tu' dhi' gu tukaa' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu chio'ñ na ba' jix duu jir bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa'.
Ba' jix aa' jixchamaam gu tanoolh kɨkbo gu xibh na ba' jix duu gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr dhaibu gook bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ na ba' jix duu gu u'vɨ jix duñia'; gio ba' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ba' jix duñia' gu tas jix duñia' gu tukaa'; jano' ba' gu tanoolh mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' na ba' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu xibh gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' vaak zel.
Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook jix búup ta'tak bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Jebus gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' ju'ñdharan gu Jebus gu tanoolh ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai'; gio ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jano' dhi' kiicham gu Jebuseos na ba' gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matgɨm kiicham jix bhai'x cham ka't gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr va'k bɨɨx ka'm gu Gabaa; jano' ba' jix aa' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n jix duñia' pai' na ba' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' gu Gabaa gu Rama.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas ju'ñdharan gu Gabaa ka't gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ba' baakɨi mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' gu Gabaa; na gu' baakɨk jix dhadhaa ɨrban kiicham na gu' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na ba' gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu xumai yooxi'; gio ba' ka't gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duñia' gu Gabaa gu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr pai' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu vupui jix ñi' mii' dhɨr ɨrban kiicham; gio ba' duukat.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-leem gu Judaa gu kavɨk gu Epraim pai' tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-leem gu Judaa; jano' ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch tañia' jugi na ba' gu ñi'ook gio tañia' gu takarui' suudai' u'va na ba' tu' na ba' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx tu duukam; gio ba' cham tu' tañia' uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't bɨndak; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix duñia' cham gu tukaa' ɨrban.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix maa jugi gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' tɨɨt koi'mɨk i'i.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Belial mia'n gu vaak kiki'ñgob bham gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' gu chio'ñ tu' kia'mi'ñ gu vaak na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gamai' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' cham gu ja'tkam cham dhi' cham bhai' dhi' gu chio'ñ tu' kia'mi'ñ gu vaak cham dhi' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi jano'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx na ja'p cham dhi' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhaagɨk mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ jix buusñi mai'; na pai' dhuuk jix maati' bɨx gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu vaak mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ pai' gu Jawatan ka't bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu Jawatan jix kupi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak jix buus na ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ ka't vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu vaak bɨɨx gu noobh bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Lebaantate gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham jix aa'; jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix búup ka't pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix bhɨɨ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ gu u'vɨ bɨɨx o'oo bhañ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨtda; gio ba' mɨɨjidha' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' buupui jix duñia' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' dhi' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' moor bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu oidha' gu Galaad gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu masad gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt jix duñia' gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel a'ga jix duñia' gu Mispa; gio ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ja'xñi gu ñi'ook ka't dhi' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Lebita gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ muukix; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin bɨɨx gu u'vɨ na ba' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo bhaan tu' gu Gabaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu vaak gu tukaa' bɨɨx kooda' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' ka't muukix.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhaagɨk tu' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Israeel; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix búup gui'p; gio ba' no'ch vaak zel tu' maa'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix duu dhi' bhaan gu Gabaa; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamai'chɨk bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel jix bhai'x chamaam jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x na ba' gu ja'tkam tu' bɨx jiimchu' bhaan gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel bhaan kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel mɨjɨ gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' jano' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Belial gu Gabaa na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu Israeel; gu' gu Benjamiin cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' va'k gu Benjamiin jum daa'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Gabaa na ba' jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii cham gu Gabaa jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' bɨx gu jodai bɨɨx cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Israeel mai' gu Benjamiin jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chɨkka jix tɨ'ɨ no'ch maa'n bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa maa'n.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan gu Gabaa.
Jano' ba' moor gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Israeel bhaan ju'ñdharan gu Gabaa.
Jano' ba' gamai' jano' ba' gu Gabaa gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu Israeel pai' jix duñia' maa'n gu tanoolh.

Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gook gu tanoolh gamai' gu Benjamiin gu Gabaa bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx jix duñia' gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨkka gu Jawatan Dios na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gui'p; gio ba' jix buus bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin xibhɨk dhi' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu xibh tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh gu Gabaa.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin vaik gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Gabaa na ja'p mui'kim.

Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin bhaan gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu kiicham kua'da' gu ñi'ook dhɨt gu ja'tkam na ja'p mui'kim gu bhóogɨt maa'n jix duñia' gu Bet-el gu Gabaa yooxi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Benkidos vupui bhaan no'ch na ja'p va'k; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel am:―Ja'pji; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' kɨkbo bɨx gu Israeel pai' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baal-tamar; gio ba' gio gu Israeel moor pai' gu Gabaa.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu Gabaa mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel kua'da'; gu' cham cham bhai' bhaan.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Benjamiin vupui bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Benjamiin bɨx jix duñia' gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix duñia' koko'kam; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa pai' gu Benjamiin na gu' mi'p gu ñi'ook gu Gabaa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gabaa jix duñia' bɨx kiicham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Israelitas mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix jai' gu tai na ba' kuubh kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel suulh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Benjamiin kua'da' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ tu' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan no'ch na ja'p.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk mɨmɨim kua'da' jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuubh gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu tai kiicham gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu Benjamiin choo'n; na gu' cham bhai' ka't tɨbiap bhaan.
Jano' ba' suulh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki; gu' kiicham gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Benjamiin dɨr gu Menukâ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Gabaa bhaan pai' gu tas.
Jano' ba' ia'rɨ gu Benjamiin mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk jiboi'ññor bhaan oidha' jix gaki gu jodai' na jix uam gu Rimmoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ka'm gu Gidom gook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Benjamiin jix koko' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Gu' gu' suulh jiboi'ññor oidha' jix gaki gu jodai' na jix uam gu Rimmoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu jodai' na jix uam gu Rimmoon maakobh masaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax kiicham bɨx ka't gaagam; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tai bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Mispa bham; gio ba' no'ch maa'n mar u'vɨ gu Benjamiin gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu ñi'ook gui'p.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu ja'tkam jix búup gu xibh gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' chɨkka bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu masad mia'n gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa bham; mi' dhɨr koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gui'p; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ na ba' jix duñia' gu Nosotros gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham mar u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch oi'ñdha' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel cham ka't jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jabes-galaad ka't tɨbiap yooxi' gu masad.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' cham ka't gu chio'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jabes-galaad.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jabes-galaad gu u'vɨ a'aalh.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'; gio ba' kooda' bɨx gu chio'ñ bɨx gu u'vɨ bhɨɨya' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jabes-galaad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix daa gu chio'ñ aichdhak yooxi' gu Silo gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhañ ñiokda' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin mi'p gu jodai' na jix uam gu Rimmoon tɨɨt bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' suulh jano' ba' gu Benjamiin; gio ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ na jix do'ig gu u'vɨ gu Jabes-galaad; gu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Benjamiin gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa gu ñi'ook gui'p; na gu' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ na ba' jix duñia' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ ka't jix duñia' gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gui'p; na gu' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't gu Benjamiin na gu' cham ka't bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Na gu' no'ch cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu u'vɨ gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' jano' xoi'kam gui'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' tas cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo gu Bet-el gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Bet-el gu Sikêm saagi'ñ gu Lebona.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk jix buus ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Silo gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va maa'n gu u'vɨ na ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Silo gu oidha' gu Benjamiin.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu ja'tkam no'ch; gio ba' xoi'kam jix duñia' no'ch pai'; na gu' no'ch bhɨɨ'ñdham cham gu u'vɨ na ba' bɨx; na cham jix duñia' jix maa na ba' jano' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix duu; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar jɨ'dɨlh jix daa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gio maa'n bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gamai' maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' maa'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui.
